conflicts.remarks_quote: Whether to use the default bend allowance is set during the initialization of this base flange and cannot be changed.
conflicts.why: 示例把 Initialize 第2参标成 UseDefaultBendAllowance，官方签名却是 OverrideDefaultBendAllowance（true=覆盖默认）。同一 False 按两种命名得到相反结论，不能同时成立。

conflicts.remarks_quote: If this property is false, then use [[IBaseFlangeFeatureData::GetCustomBendAllowance]] to get the custom bend allowance used to [[initialize]] this base flange.
conflicts.example_quote: Call swBaseFlangeFeat.Initialize(False, False, cba, False, swSheetMetalReliefTypes_e.swSheetMetalReliefRectangular, True, 0.8, 0#, 0#)
conflicts.why: 官方 Initialize 的 Parameters 逐字写 CustomBendAllowance「valid only if OverrideDefaultBendAllowance is true」；示例该位传 False 仍传入已配置的 cba。
